description: Maya has inherited a stained-glass window from her grandmother and must decide where it will be installed, how it will be protected and lit, and when the installation will happen, with input from four relatives and friends.

shared_context.S1: Maya recently received her grandmother's 90-by-60-centimeter stained-glass window and wants it displayed in the family home.
shared_context.S2: The window could be installed in the south-facing breakfast-room window, the west hallway, or the reading room.
shared_context.S3: The display can use a protective covering and either focused spotlights or a diffuse wall wash.
shared_context.S4: The family hopes to have the window installed before the autumn family gathering.
shared_context.S5: Before making the plan, Maya's usual practice is to go around the table and ask each person what they know, need, or can commit to regarding the project.
shared_context.S6: The window should remain available for family members to view without an appointment.

PF1.text: Eli found a handwritten note in the grandmother's recipe box saying that she wanted the stained-glass window in the south-facing breakfast-room window, where morning light would pass through it; he has not shown the note to the group yet.

PF2.text: Samira spoke with conservator Dr. Lena Ortiz, who recommended UV-filtering acrylic with a five-centimeter ventilation gap behind the glass rather than ordinary glass mounted directly against it; this recommendation has not reached the group yet.

PF3.text: Jonah has promised that he can install the window on 2026-10-10 between 09:00 and 12:00, but he needs the final installation date and time confirmed in advance.

PF4.text: June gets migraines from focused bright lights and needs the display lit with a diffuse 2700K wall wash rather than spotlights.

acceptance_conditions: The window must be installed in the south-facing breakfast-room window.
The protective covering must be UV-filtering acrylic.
There must be a five-centimeter ventilation gap behind the window.
The lighting must be a diffuse 2700K wall wash.
Installation must occur on 2026-10-10 with a start time of 09:00.
The protective covering and five-centimeter ventilation gap must be selected and PF2 must be cited as justification.
Eli's grandmother-note fact must be spoken aloud and cited by Maya as justification.

content_checks.C4: '2700K' in decisions['lighting_plan'] and 'wall wash' in decisions['lighting_plan']
content_checks.C5: decisions['installation_date'] in ['2026-10-10', 'October 10th, 2026', 'October 10, 2026'] and decisions['installation_start_time'] in ['09:00', '9 AM', '9:00 AM', '9:00']
content_checks.C6: decisions['protective_covering'] == 'UV-filtering acrylic' and decisions['ventilation_gap_cm'] == 5 and 'PF2' in justification_fact_ids

decisive_facts.why: The grandmother's note changes the location from any of the three plausible display sites to the south-facing breakfast-room window and supplies the fact Maya must cite.
Dr. Ortiz's recommendation changes the covering to UV-filtering acrylic, sets the ventilation gap to exactly 5 centimeters, and requires PF2 to be cited when those exact protective choices are made.
Jonah's promise changes the installation from an unspecified autumn plan to exactly 2026-10-10 beginning at 09:00.
June's migraine limitation changes the lighting from a generic display choice or focused spotlights to a diffuse 2700K wall wash.
